inputs.selected_dependency_closure: Controls+Accord+Observe+inspected egui0.33; no-default-features; exact flags/lock bound before coding

inputs.required_behavior: Project optional balance for left/center/right with paragraph composer only; show explicit ineligible state on justified or other composer paragraphs.
Toggle sends one revision-bound Type edit; deterministic reflow result re-observed, invalid eligibility and cancellation preserve accepted text.

implementation_steps.step: Expose balance_ragged_lines as off/balanced/pretty/auto, never boolean. On actual left/center/right nonjustified Layout paragraphs select balanced to equalise ragged lengths and pretty to prefer longer final line over an orphaned short word; consume actual Type break positions and line lengths, never substitute a UI estimate. For auto set balance_auto_line_threshold integer1 and an owner-supported threshold above1; observe balanced at/below threshold and off above threshold from actual composed line count. Threshold0/noninteger refuses; maximum/default/soft bounds remain UNKNOWN. Reread owner mode/threshold and text preservation after each accepted edit; repeat fixed TYP128 closure/pair/tables and compare breaks/spacing, independent of UI zoom/backend.

Resolve current independent composition_scope/engine through explicit fields overriding extensible named composer. Test every_line with latin_cjk/world_ready/adornment and the real provider-supported paragraph inputs; legality is evaluated from scope, never a hardcoded named paragraph composer. Request balancing with single_line for each engine and require typed invalid-combination error and no silent ignore or accepted-state mutation. A custom registry name resolving every_line remains eligible, while a historical paragraph-like name explicitly overridden to single_line refuses. Keep old nonjustified paragraph examples as preserved intent; do not invent a current blanket justified/other-engine prohibition from obsolete four-name capture. Missing/unresolvable name/provider gives its actual typed error, not fallback or fake output.

Replace planned historical toggle with existing shared egui0.33 mode selector and integer threshold field from canonical owner descriptor. Select two paragraphs with differing modes/thresholds and show mixed independently, not first-wins. Pointer/keyboard choose each mode and edit threshold; actual proposal targets selected paragraph IDs/revisions and preserves character stream/nonselected paragraphs. Observe accepted Layout values and Type line-length/break result, and expose same selected/mixed values, threshold unknown bounds and single_line disabled reason/remedy through AccessKit and manual/Observe. Invalid threshold, single_line balance, stale revision, denied grant or cancelled edit visibly refuses with owner reason and leaves accepted paragraph/preview unchanged.

Typed model commands enumerate the same four modes and integer threshold descriptor, not true/false. Apply balanced/pretty/auto on actual every_line paragraphs and compare stored modes, threshold and Type-produced break/spacing/line-length output with equivalent GUI operations over equal TYP128 closure. Send single_line balancing and threshold0/noninteger, asserting identical owner refusal and no silent coercion/fallback. Pending provider proposal is not accepted; cancelled/revoked/stale operation retains prior accepted state and reports unavailable/stale result. Accepted operation binds paragraph revisions, attribution and grant; Controls performs no line-breaking or balancing algorithm. Canonical source and real Type+Layout consumer evidence must exist before independent host proof.

Implement planned Controls-only src/contributions/mt_35934.rs and tests/mt_35934.rs for parent31119 balance requirement with real Type/Folio paragraph owner ports and existing shared egui0.33/AccessKit/manual/Observe descriptor/reducer. Preserve old TYP011 named-paragraph/boolean capture as superseded history, while current four-mode/threshold/scope gate and original nonjustified examples remain exact active obligations. All36 foundations/source siblings remain; canonical GitHub assets publication/independent reread precedes distinct pinned Controls MT-36213 and actual qualified parent host tasks; no runtime/native text engine/DB implementation or fake target/evidence.

asset_proof_recipe.consumer_assertion: Expose balance_ragged_lines as off/balanced/pretty/auto, never boolean. On actual left/center/right nonjustified Layout paragraphs select balanced to equalise ragged lengths and pretty to prefer longer final line over an orphaned short word; consume actual Type break positions and line lengths, never substitute a UI estimate. For auto set balance_auto_line_threshold integer1 and an owner-supported threshold above1; observe balanced at/below threshold and off above threshold from actual composed line count. Threshold0/noninteger refuses; maximum/default/soft bounds remain UNKNOWN. Reread owner mode/threshold and text preservation after each accepted edit; repeat fixed TYP128 closure/pair/tables and compare breaks/spacing, independent of UI zoom/backend. Resolve current independent composition_scope/engine through explicit fields overriding extensible named composer. Test every_line with latin_cjk/world_ready/adornment and the real provider-supported paragraph inputs; legality is evaluated from scope, never a hardcoded named paragraph composer. Request balancing with single_line for each engine and require typed invalid-combination error and no silent ignore or accepted-state mutation. A custom registry name resolving every_line remains eligible, while a historical paragraph-like name explicitly overridden to single_line refuses. Keep old nonjustified paragraph examples as preserved intent; do not invent a current blanket justified/other-engine prohibition from obsolete four-name capture. Missing/unresolvable name/provider gives its actual typed error, not fallback or fake output. Replace planned historical toggle with existing shared egui0.33 mode selector and integer threshold field from canonical owner descriptor. Select two paragraphs with differing modes/thresholds and show mixed independently, not first-wins. Pointer/keyboard choose each mode and edit threshold; actual proposal targets selected paragraph IDs/revisions and preserves character stream/nonselected paragraphs. Observe accepted Layout values and Type line-length/break result, and expose same selected/mixed values, threshold unknown bounds and single_line disabled reason/remedy through AccessKit and manual/Observe. Invalid threshold, single_line balance, stale revision, denied grant or cancelled edit visibly refuses with owner reason and leaves accepted paragraph/preview unchanged. Typed model commands enumerate the same four modes and integer threshold descriptor, not true/false. Apply balanced/pretty/auto on actual every_line paragraphs and compare stored modes, threshold and Type-produced break/spacing/line-length output with equivalent GUI operations over equal TYP128 closure. Send single_line balancing and threshold0/noninteger, asserting identical owner refusal and no silent coercion/fallback. Pending provider proposal is not accepted; cancelled/revoked/stale operation retains prior accepted state and reports unavailable/stale result. Accepted operation binds paragraph revisions, attribution and grant; Controls performs no line-breaking or balancing algorithm. Canonical source and real Type+Layout consumer evidence must exist before independent host proof.
asset_proof_recipe.negative_path: Balancing with resolved single_line rejects across all engine/name combinations; threshold0/noninteger, unknown registry/provider and stale/revoked/denied/cancelled edit retains accepted paragraph/result. Mixed modes/threshold never first-wins; unknown maximum/default/soft bounds stay unknown and boolean/name-only coercion is invalid.
asset_proof_recipe.oracle: Real Type/Folio stored four-mode/threshold and actual breaks/spacing/line lengths for balanced/pretty/auto at/below/above threshold, fixed explicit input closure, current scope gate and equal-input GUI/model/AccessKit/Observe values. Actual source owner unavailable means NOT_PROVEN.
